meta.title: The Daily Godoy — Joaquín Godoy, Software Engineer
meta.description: The Daily Godoy, morning edition. Being an account of the works, appointments and telegrams of Joaquín Godoy, software engineer of Buenos Aires.

items: A MILLION ENTRIES RECONCILED BEFORE THE COFFEE COOLED
THE NIGHTLY BUILD COMPLETED BEFORE THE LAMPLIGHTER MADE HIS ROUNDS
MEMORY LEAK CORNERED AND SEALED BEFORE IT REACHED THE CELLAR
LATEST DEPLOY ARRIVED ON FRIDAY AND NOT A SOUL WAS AWAKENED
THE SERVERS ENDURED THE MIDNIGHT RUSH WITHOUT LOSS OF COMPOSURE
THE PIPELINE RAN ALL WINTER WITHOUT A DAY OF CONVALESCENCE
OUTAGE FORETOLD BY THE INSTRUMENTS AND AVERTED BEFORE BREAKFAST
A QUERY CROSSED THREE MILLION ROWS AND RETURNED BEFORE THE INK DRIED
THE OLD MONOLITH RETIRED WITH HONOURS; ITS DUTIES ASSUMED BY LESSER ENGINES
THE CLOCKS WERE TURNED BACK ONE VERSION AND ALL WAS FORGIVEN
CROWD AT THE GATES DIVIDED EVENLY AMONG TWELVE DOORMEN
CONTRAPTIONS EXAMINED HOURLY BY A THOUSAND TIRELESS INSPECTORS
TWO GENTLEMEN AMENDED THE SAME PARAGRAPH; PISTOLS AT DAWN AVERTED BY A CAREFUL MERGE
AN INQUEST INTO THE FAULTY LEDGER NAMED THE INSPECTOR’S OWN HAND
THE CACHE REMEMBERED WHAT THE DATABASE HAD SWORN TO FORGET
